! go-jsonschema validate --schema-file schema.json instance.json
stderr 'less than minimum 1'

-- schema.json --
{
  "$defs": {
    "positive": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1 }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "count": { "$ref": "#/$defs/positive" }
  },
  "required": ["count"]
}
-- instance.json --
{"count": 0}
